rationale: AJ is building dexterous robotic systems with a focus on hardware-software co-design and robot learning, while Akshath brings deep SLAM and perception expertise from his research engineering background. Both are based in San Francisco, share core robotics and ROS knowledge, and can directly complement each other—AJ's manipulation focus pairs well with Akshath's work on localization and autonomous systems, two critical layers for practical mobile manipulation.
intro_message: AJ Chahal, meet Akshath Singhal — you're both building the perception and manipulation stack for practical robotics, and your expertise in hardware-software integration and SLAM could be a natural fit to explore together.
